name: TiDB
description: Queries and updates TiDB, a distributed SQL database with vector search, from MCP clients: run SQL, switch databases and manage users in plain language.

skills.name: Run Read-Only SQL
skills.description: Runs read-only SQL queries against a TiDB database from natural-language requests in Cursor, Claude Desktop or another MCP client.

skills.name: Execute SQL Statements
skills.description: Executes DML or DDL statements, singly or as a batch, to change TiDB tables and the data stored in them.

skills.name: Browse Databases and Tables
skills.description: Lists the databases and tables in a TiDB Cloud Starter instance and switches the active database for later queries.

skills.name: Manage Database Users
skills.description: Creates and removes TiDB database users with a username and password directly from an MCP client conversation.
